VeraGridEngine.Utils.SugiyamaLayered.model module

Core graph model for the Sugiyama layered layout pipeline.

This module stores the graph primitives manipulated by the layout phases. The classes are intentionally light and explicit so the pipeline can inspect and mutate coordinates without hidden behavior.

class VeraGridEngine.Utils.SugiyamaLayered.SugiyamaOptionResolver(registry: dict[str, OptionDefinition] | None = None)[source]

Bases: object

resolve_for_element(graph_options: dict[str, Any], element_options: dict[str, Any] | None = None) → dict[str, Any][source]

Resolve options for one graph element.

The algorithm starts from registry defaults, then applies graph-level overrides, and finally element-specific overrides. The precedence must be explicit because all phases inspect the resolved values repeatedly.

Parameters:
